entries.test: Whether public evidence such as developer surveys, adoption figures and industry employment data shows AI substantially changing how software is written.
entries.note: 'Big impact' is vague, but most readers would read it the same way: widespread, substantial change to coding practice. The post gives no horizon, though the NYT panel may have used one.

entries.test: Whether public evidence on schools and universities, such as adoption rates, policy changes and changes in how teaching and assessment work, shows AI substantially changing education.
entries.note: 'Large impact' looks like a point on the NYT panel's answer scale. The post doesn't say whether he means a good or bad impact, and his 'words of caution' are qualifications, not a real condition.
